chunks: "When a man urinates, he should not touch his private part with his right hand."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about touching the private part with the right hand while urinating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an etiquette-related legal instruction concerning relieving oneself. It teaches that a man should not touch his private part with his right hand while urinating, reflecting norms of taharah and bodily etiquette in Islamic practice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.55 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"When a man urinates, he should not touch his private parts with his right hand."
